description: This Java source file defines an abstract helper class 'GrepHelper' and its two implementations for GREP command construction based on platform capabilities. It provides methods to generate grep commands with regex pattern support, considering different command-line tools (pcre2grep and egrep).

classes.name: GrepHelper
classes.description: Abstract class providing interface for GREP command helper implementations.

classes.name: GrepHelper.PcreGrepHelper
classes.description: Implementation for platforms supporting pcre2grep, with specific regex patterns.

classes.name: GrepHelper.BsdGrepHelper
classes.description: Implementation for platforms using egrep, with BSD-style regex patterns.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getHelper
methods.description: Factory method returning platform-specific GrepHelper instance.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getCommandName
methods.description: Returns the name of the grep command for the platform.

methods.name: GrepHelper.getMetaCharacters
methods.description: Provides regex meta-character patterns supported by the specific grep implementation.

methods.name: GrepHelper.buildCommand
methods.description: Constructs the grep command string with pattern and options (before, after, ignoreCase).
